item.title: Nodex 0.5.10
item.description:
### Changed - The command palette opens on the search field, with its scope tabs at the bottom next to each scope's options: Everywhere or one Project, a folder, or file types. Each result is one line, with the title on the left and its Project on the right. A second line appears only to show why it matched. A spinner in the corner shows while a search is still running.
### Fixed - Nodex starts and upgrades normally after a chat continues work that it previously reported ready for review. - Chat search and heartbeats recover when an action is canceled during Agent startup. - Space content loads when a window opens during startup, without needing a reload. - A message that did not go through from your phone stays in the chat. It used to vanish behind a brief notice, and sending it again could deliver it twice. It now shows that it is sending, waits out a short gap in the connection, and if it could not be sent says why and offers Retry and Delete; Retry never delivers the same message twice. Starting a new chat again after a lost connection opens the same chat instead of a second one. - Stop on your phone stops the Run you are looking at. If that Run finished a moment earlier, Stop no longer reports a failure or reaches the next Run. - `/compact`, `/goal` and signing out sent while an Agent is working wait for their own turn instead of failing. - Starting a chat from your phone while work is paused asks you to resume work, instead of reporting that the request could not be completed.
